classification: Original representative training equipment. Each model illustrates an equipment architecture. Construction, circuit ratings and simplified interfaces are identified in the lesson. Product literature documents the features used for comparison.
coordinateContract: Recipe Y-up, +Z operating front. Each electrical ID has its own physical cable mouth and outward entry vector. Wall accessories are wired at the rear. DIN protective devices have upper and lower banks, motor boards face upward, and fronts opened for service have connection blocks behind their covers. Source and meter earth connections represent the separate protective path at the installation boundary. The valve flying lead ends in a separate connector strip. Circuit IDs stay fixed when inspecting or moving equipment.

sources.title: Dimplex PLXE Series C · dimensions, photographs and rating
sources.architecture: The 500 W PLX050E has a powder-coated louvred steel face, finned element, H-frame mounting and three-core flex. Published envelope 450 × 430 × 108 mm.

sources.title: Dimplex PLXE Series C · controls, mounting and earthing
sources.architecture: Mounting figure 2 and the six-key manual controls. The study model shows the bare ends of a shortened three-core lead. Rear pressed details and internals are representative.

sources.title: Dimplex · panel heater flex exit
sources.architecture: The manufacturer lists the PLX050E with a right-hand flex exit. The trade cable-entry drawing places it low on that side.

sources.title: Grothe CROMA 100A 43170 · dimensional drawing
sources.architecture: Original 163 × 190 × 50.4 mm housing after the maker’s dimensioned drawing, including the silver side strips, hinged 4 mm frosted face, outlet and 60 mm mounting pitch. Grothe’s newer prose datasheet rounds the envelope to 165 × 190 × 50 mm.

sources.title: Grothe CROMA 100A · installer photographs and two-call wiring diagram D
sources.architecture: Figures 2, 3a and 6a show the empty cell bay, K1 cable entry, front screw bank and setting controls. Diagram D uses the two 8–12 V supply connections and inputs C1 and C2. Diagram C uses the fifth connection V for dry contacts. Hidden PCB, speaker, screw sections and wire dress are interpreted study geometry.

sources.title: Switch Components RG1-1A-DC-1-B · two-pin panel rocker
sources.architecture: Manufacturer photographs document the unlit black rocker, two pairs of ribbed spring catches, numbered moulding and two pierced blades. The study fitting clips into a small worktop switch panel.

sources.title: RG1-1A-DC-1-B · dimensions and circuit, rev B
sources.architecture: The current rating in the electrical specification is 10 A at 28 V DC. Numbered 1 and 2 blades are 6.35 mm wide and separated by 9.3 mm. Position 3 has no terminal. A 0.75 to 3 mm panel takes a 27.6 by 13.0 mm cutout.

sources.title: BG 815-01 · three-pole fan isolator
sources.architecture: A 10 A three-pole rocker on an 86 × 86 mm plate, overall depth 22.2 mm. The maker’s rear photograph shows staggered L1, L2 and N entries in two rows, with screws accessed separately above and below the cassette. The timer fan diagram uses L1 for switched line and L2 for permanent line.

sources.title: Friedland D814 Sesame · product photograph
sources.architecture: Unlit white cap with a dark bezel on a slim white case. Outer dimensions are 55 × 24 × 18 mm in the Friedland chimes catalogue. Small mouldings are reconstructed.

sources.title: Friedland D814 · cover, fixings and rear connections
sources.architecture: The manufacturer’s fitting sheet shows two wire screws behind the cartridge, two separate fixing holes, a clip-off shell and a 1–24 V, 2 A rating.

sources.title: Hager device mounting · rail clip and operating fronts
sources.architecture: Page 4 shows the lower rail clip and the fronts of a two-module RCCB, RCBO and one-module breaker. The training cutaway illustrates the clip and separate wire and screwdriver access.

sources.title: Hager NBN116A · one-pole breaker
sources.architecture: Front photograph, single grey lever, one pair of screw terminals and a 17.5 × 83 × 70 mm body.

sources.title: Hager NBN316A · three-pole breaker
sources.architecture: Three linked poles and a single 52.5 × 83 × 70 mm assembly.

sources.title: Hager CDA240U · two-pole RCCB
sources.architecture: One lever, a separate test button and terminals numbered 1 and 3 at the top, 2 and 4 below. Body 35 × 83 × 70 mm.

sources.title: Hager CDA440U · four-pole RCCB
sources.architecture: One operating lever for four poles. The neutral pair on this model is on the right. Body 70 × 83 × 70 mm.

sources.title: Hager ADA516D · RCBO
sources.architecture: Two-module RCBO. Neutral is on the right, with the test button below the handle. Body 35 × 83 × 68 mm.

sources.title: MK Electric Logic Plus K701WHI · shaver supply unit
sources.architecture: Original model of the 86 × 146 mm output face with 120.6 mm fixing centres and interlocked 115 V and 230 V positions. The lesson connects the isolated 230 V pair. The internal study tags are separated from the transformer to make measurements possible.

sources.title: Radium 11118941 · 60 W clear A55 B22d
sources.architecture: The archived 230 V tungsten bulb has a 22 mm bayonet base, 55 mm diameter, clear round envelope and a maximum overall length of 97 mm.

sources.title: BG 811 single one-way plate · rear product view
sources.architecture: Two recessed cable windows. The rear photograph shows two upper fixing ears and a third case screw inside the lower curved recess, separate from the wire clamps. The plate has cruciform mouldings below the fixing bushes.

sources.title: BG 812 two-way plate · rear and side views
sources.architecture: 86 × 86 × 23.3 mm white plate, 60.3 mm fixing pitch, screw covers and narrow rocker. Three rectangular rear conductor mouths are separated from the captive clamp screws accessed at the ends. COM is above L2 (left) and L1 (right) as seen from the rear. The lower case screw sits between the two feet. The concealed changeover, core seats and individual radii are study reconstructions.

sources.title: BG 813 intermediate plate · four rear terminals
sources.architecture: Four recessed contacts in two pairs, four captured case fixings and a reinforced central bridge.

sources.title: BG 842 two-gang switch · paired cassette rear view
sources.architecture: Opposing switch modules share a fixing plate. The paired one-way lesson populates two active terminals per rocker.

sources.title: BG 661 ceiling rose · exposed clear base photograph
sources.architecture: Photo A6 shows eight captive screws in three brass groups (three neutral, three loop and two lamp line), a separate earth block, three round fixing holes and one slanted slot. The rectangular wiring opening is above a separate knockout marked REMOVE.

sources.title: S. Lilley 3015E and BC7/BC8 ceramic interiors · catalogue page 2
sources.architecture: The 3015E uses a 48 mm two-fixing base with 40 mm centres, a 45° batten body, shade ring and earth terminal. The catalogue shows two separate brass contacts in a divided ceramic insert. The clamp positions inside the training service view preserve the saved L, N and PE connections.

sources.title: S. Lilley 3015E · photograph and section A–A
sources.architecture: The maker shows a hollow spun-brass back, rolled shade ring, two bayonet slots, a separate earth lug and a 45° mounting angle. The study holder retains its original lamp datum. Internal screw positions, springs and wire seats are illustrative.

sources.title: Hager Ireland residential enclosures · Gamma 13 cable entry and accessories
sources.architecture: Gamma provides pre-marked cable entries at the top, bottom and sides. The training example uses prepared entries and an optional transparent door.

sources.title: Hager Ireland WMPS12 wall switch
sources.architecture: WMPS12 is a 10AX flush-mounted single rocker with an 86 × 86 mm glossy face. Its data sheet also lists a loop terminal. The lab’s one- and two-way cassette layouts follow BG 811 and 812 rear photographs.

sources.title: MENNEKES 400 V five-pole PowerTOP 3821
sources.architecture: Five nickel-plated mating pins, marked earth contact at six o’clock, separate screw terminations and cable gland.

sources.title: MENNEKES protective conductor contact and clock positions
sources.architecture: The PE contact is larger. Front views of the complementary plug and socket mirror one another.

sources.title: Hager Ireland ADA532D product data
sources.architecture: Top and bottom screw connections, central operating handle, device identification and test button. Actual displayed ratings belong to the current simulated circuit. The bench opens out its lower approach so that it can be reached above the mat.

sources.title: IE-N05VVH4-U and IE-N05VVH4-R flat Irish cable
sources.architecture: Flat common sheath and individually insulated cores including the protective conductor.

sources.title: Eland H05VV-F flexible cable
sources.architecture: Round outer sheath, flexible copper cores and individually coloured insulation.

sources.title: ABB miniature circuit breaker cutaway
sources.architecture: Fixed/moving contacts, bimetal, magnetic solenoid, trip lever, separated arc plates and DIN clip.

sources.title: Phoenix Contact screw connection technology
sources.architecture: Current cage, captive pressure plate and threaded actuator protect conductors from screw rotation. Exact tension sleeve design varies by product.

sources.title: Schneider TeSys Deca contactor data
sources.architecture: Three main normally-open poles, AC coil and distinct auxiliary contacts. Teaching geometry uses double-break contacts and a laminated magnetic core.

sources.title: ABB low-voltage motor construction catalogue
sources.architecture: Stator frame, rotor/shaft, bearings, end shields, terminal board, fan and fan cover. Generic motor architecture only: the models have no explosion-protection claim.

sources.title: MK Logic Plus catalogue
sources.architecture: Domestic socket safety shutters, switch mechanisms and separated wiring chambers. Teaching accessory body is original.

sources.title: Resideo motorised zone valve construction
sources.architecture: Motorised powerhead, spring return, manual lever and auxiliary end switch. Bench terminal layout is not the manufacturer's flying-lead termination.

sources.title: Triton T80 Easi-Fit Plus parts architecture
sources.architecture: Heater can, pressure/flow module, solenoid, thermal cut-out and outlet. Generic physical architecture only.

sources.title: Myenergi zappi installation and operating manual
sources.architecture: Main power switching, core-balance sensing, control board, grid measurement input, enclosure seals and pilot interface. No model-specific protection certification is simulated.

sources.title: Siemens S7-1200 system manual
sources.architecture: DIN mounting, keyed removable terminal connectors, CPU and separately identified I/O. CPU logic and safety processing remain abstract.

sources.title: Grundfos pump construction instructions
sources.architecture: Volute, impeller, shaft seal, O-ring and shaft fixing. Hydraulic behaviour is an educational operating block.

sources.title: Aico Ei146e optical alarm
sources.architecture: Optical smoke chamber, backup cell and mains base; labyrinth, piezo sounder and circuit board are representative.

sources.title: Fluke tester fuse and shunt explanation
sources.architecture: Current measurement uses a low-value shunt and correct input fuse. Input protection geometry is illustrative and carries no instrument CAT rating.

sources.title: Dimplex XLE storage heater instructions
sources.architecture: Refractory energy cells around sheathed elements, insulation, thermal controls and restrained wiring.

sources.title: ABB Review low-voltage variable-speed drive architecture
sources.architecture: Supply rectifier, capacitive DC link, semiconductor inverter and control electronics. Semiconductor switching, firmware and waveforms are simplified.

sources.title: LAPP cable gland construction and functions
sources.architecture: Threaded body, compression nut, sealing insert, locknut and independent strain relief.

sources.title: Schneider distribution fundamentals: system protection
sources.architecture: MOV suppression and status indication. Transient physics and product coordination are not reproduced by the steady-state solver.

sources.title: Hager Ireland Gamma SBE8101 · photograph and dimensions
sources.architecture: Two rows of thirteen modules, white insulating shell, translucent door and separate neutral/earth terminations. Reference envelope 250 × 375 × 103 mm. Our populated circuits are teaching layouts.

sources.title: Hager Ireland Invicta JK104B · product photograph
sources.architecture: Plain steel door with latch, facing outgoing phase banks, 125 A four-way TP&N chassis and independent glands. Mounting alone makes no electrical path in the lab.

sources.title: Hager Invicta 3 dimension drawing
sources.architecture: Drawing dimensions of JK104B, 465 × 500 × 132.5 mm. The study fixture keeps these exterior proportions.

sources.title: LEDVANCE LS V -500/830/5 · photograph, cut marks and dimensions
sources.architecture: The single-colour cut section measures 100 × 8 × 1.5 mm. Seven warm-white LEDs sit between pairs of copper lands. The +24V and minus markings, cut line and solder joints follow the maker’s image. The worktop course uses 500 mm per side at 5 W per metre. Other exercises set the load separately.

sources.title: LEDVANCE tape and controller installation diagrams
sources.architecture: Flexible circuit, copper cutting and solder lands, common positive and separate warm and cool returns. The bench simplifies the controller and terminal count.

sources.title: Tridonic 300/350 mA constant-current driver drawing
sources.architecture: Flat two-ended housing and separated line and LED terminations. The model’s extra protective endpoint is retained for compatible study circuits. The reference product is Class II.

sources.title: Tridonic 12/24 V constant-voltage driver
sources.architecture: Separated mains and regulated DC output ends. The simulator uses the selected voltage and power parameters.

sources.title: ifm IES204 sensor drawing and cable connections
sources.architecture: Threaded proximity body, front sensing surface and three separate PNP leads.

sources.title: Belimo 24 V three-point rotary actuator
sources.architecture: Three-point drive and external position indication. The lab uses shortened travel and legible training connection points.

sources.title: MAC3 Key float switch
sources.architecture: Buoyant sealed switch body pivoting on a weighted lead. The contact is brought out through the cable.

sources.title: WAGO 221 lever connector family
sources.architecture: Orange operating levers, copper common bar and spring wire entries. The represented four-entry group is generic. WAGO lists two-, three- and five-conductor examples.

sources.title: Fluke T6-600 · front/rear photographs and functions
sources.architecture: Overall outline, open yellow fork, finger guard, LCD, right-side knob, two rectangular keys, purple HOLD button and attached leads. Fluke T6-600/T6-1000 Quick Reference Guide, PN 4897598 Rev. 4, pp. 1–2, shows the battery cover, rear contact, probe docks, selector positions and one-wire seating. External features are modelled from photographs and drawings.

sources.title: KNIPEX tool catalogue · stripping and crimping jaws
sources.architecture: Original study-tool outlines use the grip, jaw and pivot forms shown. Exact individual product adjustments are illustrative.

sources.title: Wiha torque screwdriver catalogue
sources.architecture: Adjustable insulated torque driver with replaceable slim bit and molded grip.

sources.title: Friedland wired chime and front/rear call diagrams
sources.architecture: Twin sound bars, electromagnetic striker and separate call inputs. The bench uses descriptive terminal IDs and an educational supply block.

sources.title: ESB Networks cut-out and meter cabinet
sources.architecture: Sealed service enclosure, customer isolation and metering boundary.

sources.title: Schneider local control and changeover catalogue
sources.architecture: Pole separation and operating positions. The illustrated faceplate is generic.

sources.title: Philips CoreLine batten
sources.architecture: Linear housing, light source and diffuser.

sources.title: Resideo heating controls
sources.architecture: Separate thermostats, programmer and valve controls with wiring diagrams.

sources.title: Dimplex heating mat drawing
sources.architecture: Heating cable on a mesh with a separate floor probe.

sources.title: Manrose XF100S · room face, 100 mm duct and standard motor
sources.architecture: Original fascia, fixed guard and two screw caps compared with the maker's photograph. The impeller pitch and inaccessible motor parts are educational.

sources.title: Manrose XF100 · dimension drawing
sources.architecture: 163 mm square, 30 mm fascia and 45 mm long outlet of 98 mm diameter. Use the fitted unit's rating label on a job.

sources.title: Manrose standard extractor · fixing and two-wire block, diagram 1
sources.architecture: Under-cover live and neutral terminals beside the motor, wall-fixing slots, cable entry and Class II construction. The standard model uses a separate timer in this lesson.

sources.title: Vent-Axia fan catalogue
sources.architecture: Grille, duct and humidity/timer controls.

sources.title: Schneider Harmony control stations
sources.architecture: Front operator, selector or lamp with separate rear contacts.

sources.title: Schneider TeSys overload
sources.architecture: Reset and current adjustment mechanisms.

sources.title: VARILIGHT HQ1A one-way rotary dimmer, front and rear photographs
sources.architecture: 85 mm square plate, 60.3 mm fixing centres, 15.5 mm rear projection and 3.2 mm terminal bores from the datasheet. Knob, rear case, fixing lugs and cable entries follow the photographs. Smaller proportions and hidden clamps are reconstructed. The bench uses equivalent resistance.

sources.title: Hager ST303 bell transformer
sources.architecture: Separated primary and secondary windings. The teaching model exposes the core.

sources.title: Grant Ireland Aerona drawings
sources.architecture: Outdoor fan, heat exchanger and cabinet.

sources.title: Schneider XMP pressure switch
sources.architecture: Mechanical inlet and switching mechanism. The bench adds an indicating gauge.

sources.title: Benincà BULL sliding gate
sources.architecture: Geared drive, pinion and travel limits.

sources.title: Fronius inverter and battery connections
sources.architecture: Separate inverter and energy-store interfaces. The bench power model is simplified.

sources.title: Hager fuse carrier drawing
sources.architecture: Cylindrical fuse and removable carrier.

sources.title: CQR magnetic door contacts
sources.architecture: Dimensions and installation of the fixed surface housing and moving magnet. The 24 V lighting lesson uses a load-rated switching output.

sources.title: Lightdream LD2022 · load-rated cabinet control
sources.architecture: A magnet sensor and a 5 A switching output operate a 12 or 24 V DC strip when a cabinet door opens. The study circuit combines the sensor and switch into one contact.

sources.title: Littelfuse cartridge clips
sources.architecture: Cartridge retained between two conducting clips.

sources.title: Grant Ireland boiler manuals
sources.architecture: Enclosure, service cover and heating controls. Generic interface on the bench.

sources.title: Electrolux ceramic cooker
sources.architecture: Freestanding hob and oven controls.

sources.title: STIEBEL ELTRON immersion heater drawing
sources.architecture: Heating element, mounting flange and terminal cover.

sources.title: Somfy shutter drive limit controls
sources.architecture: Tubular motor, shaft and limit adjustment.

sources.title: Ansell recessed downlight
sources.architecture: Circular bezel, spring fixing and rear connector. ELV bench variant uses a driver.

sources.title: Ansell emergency bulkhead
sources.architecture: Diffuser, charge indicator and battery-backed lamp.

sources.title: Timeguard lighting controls
sources.architecture: Different optics for daylight and occupancy sensing.

sources.title: Phoenix Contact TRIO power supply
sources.architecture: Separate line and DC output connections.

sources.title: Einhell air compressor catalogue
sources.architecture: Motor, cylinder, receiver tank and pressure controls.

sources.title: Pilz PNOZ X3 safety relay
sources.architecture: Reset and feedback connections and force-guided output contacts. The represented UI is generic.

sources.title: Shelly Plus 1 terminals
sources.architecture: Separate switch input and relay contacts. The wall box is generic.

sources.title: KNIPEX 11 01 160 adjustable insulation stripper
sources.architecture: V-cut opposing jaws and a knurled adjustment stop leave the copper intact on a matching conductor.

sources.title: KNIPEX 97 53 04 self-adjusting ferrule crimping pliers
sources.architecture: Closed four-sided die, lateral ferrule entry and ratchet handles produce a square ferrule profile.

sources.title: BG Electrical 824 rear photograph and dimension drawing
sources.architecture: Double unswitched socket. The 146.5 × 86 mm face, twin earths and fixing centres follow the drawing. The grey cassette, top screw wells, rear entrances and pressed earth strap follow the rear photograph. Small mouldings are reconstructed from the photograph. The model is original.

sources.title: BG Electrical 851 · front, rear and side photographs
sources.architecture: The red flag is painted on the rocker. Beside the captive carrier is a small opening notch. The rear photo shows upper N LOAD, L IN and L LOAD, a lower N IN, a two-ended metal earth strap and the cord grip. The original 86 mm plate uses the published 60.3 mm fixing pitch. Small mouldings and hidden spring details are illustrative.

sources.title: BG NXSWFCUIL-H · terminal diagrams and captive fuse carrier
sources.architecture: The side-by-side supply and appliance diagrams identify the four marked power terminals, both earth entries and the bottom flex exit. The carrier remains attached when withdrawn. The study view keeps its wiring intact during inspection.

sources.title: Lawson Type PL · BS 1362 cartridge dimensions
sources.architecture: The cartridge body is ceramic with two metal end caps. The published overall length is 25.4 mm and the diameter is 6.3 mm. Its internal fuse element is enclosed.
